title: Ascent to orbit: 200 kg to a 500 km near-circular orbit from Tanegashima
description: A three-degree-of-freedom ascent of a concept launcher from a pad at Tanegashima to a near-circular 500 km orbit: the US Standard Atmosphere 1976, thrust, drag, staging, a pitch schedule in altitude, a coast to apogee and a circularisation burn. The vehicle is sized by a design closure run on the simulation itself (inverse Tsiolkovsky per stage, the velocity budget scaled until the transfer apogee is the target altitude). Verified against the published atmosphere tables, the rotation of the pad, an independent element solver, one revolution of the inserted orbit and the velocity bookkeeping of the flight; displayed as a globe, a chase view and a mission-control page.
